overview.title: Platform overview
overview.summary: How the horizontal capabilities fit together.
overview.body: The platform is built from horizontal capabilities (settings, modules, feature flags, policies, AI providers, AI skills, audit log) plus optional vertical modules (helpdesk, etc.). Every feature is gated through policies (cap 27) and recorded in the audit log (cap 10). LLM calls go through the provider gateway (cap 2.1) and obey the per-skill enablement (cap 2.2).

aiSafety.title: How AI safety works
aiSafety.summary: Propose → Confirm → Audit. The AI never executes silently.
aiSafety.body: Every AI-initiated action follows three steps: (1) the AI proposes the action with a token-bound expiration; (2) the user reviews and confirms (or rejects); (3) the executor runs and the audit log records the outcome with category=ai. Policies (cap 27) can reject proposals before they ever reach the user.

helpdesk.title: Helpdesk
helpdesk.summary: Manage tickets, technicians, SLAs, KB articles, and batch tasks.
steps: Open /helpdesk to see the dashboard.

Try the AI: open the floating assistant and say 'take ticket 1001'.
Check audit-log to see the action recorded.

steps: Open /users to list members of your org.
Use /roles to manage permissions per role.
Bulk-deactivate via the AI: 'deactivate user 42' (requires confirm).

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.summary: Searchable trail of every important platform event.
steps: Open /audit-log to browse recent entries.
Filter by category (login / create / update / delete / admin / ai / security).
Each AI action lands here under category=ai with the matched policy decision.

steps: Open /ai-agents to list configured agents.
Each agent uses a skill from /admin/ai-skills and obeys policies in /admin/policies.

aiNoResponse.title: AI agent does not respond
aiNoResponse.summary: If the agent stops returning answers, start by checking the provider configured in /admin/ai-providers.
aiNoResponse.body: Check provider status in /admin/ai-providers. If error, open the Configure dialog and verify the API key. If status is ok but answers still don’t arrive, you may have hit a budget cap — check /admin/ai-usage.

forbidden403.title: 403 error performing an action
forbidden403.summary: Missing permission. Check user role or a blocking policy.
forbidden403.body: 403 means the backend denied the action. Common causes: (1) the user lacks the required permission — check /users/<id>; (2) a policy denies it — see /admin/policies. If this is an AI action, it may require approval — check /helpdesk/approvals.

sessionExpired.title: Session expires while working
sessionExpired.summary: Sign in again; tokens normally refresh automatically.
sessionExpired.body: If the session breaks mid-task, the refresh token may be stuck. Clear site cookies and sign in again. If it persists, contact support.

secureMfa.title: Enable MFA for every admin
secureMfa.summary: The single highest-impact step to secure the org.
secureMfa.body: In any production org, ensure MFA is enabled for every user with is_admin=true. Enforce via mfa_required in org settings. See /admin/settings → Security.

apiKeyRotation.title: Rotate API keys at least quarterly
apiKeyRotation.summary: Long-lived keys accumulate at customer sites, expanding attack surface.
apiKeyRotation.body: Any key older than 90 days should be flagged for rotation. Use /api-keys to mint a new key, distribute it to consumers, and revoke the old one.

auditLogReview.title: Review the audit log weekly
auditLogReview.summary: Red flags surface there before they cause damage.
auditLogReview.body: Allocate a weekly hour to /audit-log. Filter by category=ai for AI actions and scan for unusual DESTRUCTIVE entries. Export to CSV (Pro+) for compliance evidence.

security.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
security.subtitle: How to report a security issue
security.intro: We take platform security seriously and deeply appreciate the community that helps keep it safe.

report.title: How to report
report.body: Send an encrypted email to security@platform.local with a description of the vulnerability, reproduction steps, and impact assessment. We respond within 48 hours.

scope.title: In-scope
scope.body: Cross-tenant data leakage, privilege escalation, XSS / SSRF / SQLi, authentication or token-refresh flaws, and any breach of the AI guardrails are all in-scope.

outOfScope.title: Out of scope
outOfScope.body: No DoS testing, no employee impersonation attempts, no social-engineering of customers. Do not test accounts that are not yours.

safeHarbor.title: Safe harbor
safeHarbor.body: Reports made in good faith under this policy will not result in legal, criminal, or contractual action against you. With your permission we credit you on the Hall of Fame.

uptime.title: Uptime
uptime.body: The platform maintains 99.9% monthly uptime, calculated as available-minutes divided by minutes-in-month.

response.title: Support response times
response.body: P1 (critical): 1-hour response. P2 (high): 4 business hours. P3 (normal): 1 business day. P4 (question): 3 business days.

credits.title: Service credits
credits.body: If monthly uptime drops below 99.9%: 10% credit on monthly bill. Below 99.0%: 25%. Below 95.0%: 50%. Credits granted via support request.

exclusions.title: Exclusions

account.title: Account
account.body: You are responsible for passwords, MFA, and all activity under your account. Report unauthorized access via security@platform.local.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Prohibited: distributing illegal content, abuse of AI limits, attempts to breach the platform or other accounts, mass scraping. See /legal/security for vulnerability reporting.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Paid plans renew automatically. Non-payment may lead to access suspension within 14 days. Cancellation any time takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: We retain all rights in the platform code and design. You retain rights to your data; we receive a limited license to process it for the specific service.

ai.title: AI content
ai.body: The agent is a decision-support tool, not an advisor. Do not rely on AI outputs for medical, legal, or financial decisions without human verification.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: We may suspend an account for terms breach. Customer-initiated termination via /account or support. Data is deleted within 30 days of termination unless law requires longer retention.

privacy.intro: This policy applies to every user of the platform. See also /legal/subprocessors for the subprocessor list and /legal/security for the vulnerability disclosure policy.

whatWeCollect.title: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: Account data (email, name, hashed password); usage data (login times, IP, browser); content you upload to the platform; AI interactions. We do not collect marketing or tracking cookies.

whyWeCollect.title: Why we collect
whyWeCollect.body: To operate the service, security (fraud detection), billing, legal compliance. We do not sell data to third parties.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.body: Data is shared only with subprocessors (see /legal/subprocessors). Every subprocessor is bound by GDPR / DPA standards. No law enforcement disclosure absent a court order.

yourRights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
yourRights.body: Access: request a copy via /account. Correction: edit profile at /users/[your-id]. Deletion: /account. Object to processing: contact legal@platform.local.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Account data: as long as the account is active plus 30 days after deletion. Audit log: 30 days (Free), 90 days (Pro), 365 days (Enterprise). Security logs: 1 year.

dataLocation.title: Data location
dataLocation.body: Data is stored in Ireland (eu-west-1) by default. Enterprise customers in the US may request us-east-1 subject to contract.
